Written. The text covers all eight requested topics:

1. **What it is** — the three simultaneous identities (library, operations center, self-modifying harness) and how they compose
2. **Layered architecture** — FARS (files/graph), MASH (daemon/dynamics), harness (agents/skills/hooks)
3. **Three computation levels** — LLM inference by tier, deterministic scripts, planned middle layer of classifiers/Markov models
4. **Continuous learning loop** — observe → instinct → skill → tool → hook, with the failure pipeline and review pipeline
5. **Office/duty system** — 26 offices with sites, fibers, constructors, invariants, formality assessments, dispatch, chain of command
6. **Specific comparisons** — ECC (no learning, no graph), OpenClaw (flat memory vs typed graph), Cline (single-session scope), CrewAI (prose roles vs formal fibers, no persistent knowledge)
7. **Mathematical grounding** — GFRTU, bilattice with residuated pair, nuclear quartet, fiber hyperdoctrine
8. **What makes it distinct** — settlement path as design principle, algebraic learning calculus with convergence criterion, organizational frame with centuries of practice

The text is ~3,200 words, readiness: draft, written for someone who knows agent systems but has never seen this one.
